clue.text: One burning them shortly takes half of cakes outside

indicators.note: cut short, so the last letter of the name is dropped

parts.note: King Alfred, in the legend, let the peasant woman's cakes burn

indicators.note: only the first half of the six-letter word is kept, the back three letters going

parts.note: scones are small British cakes

explanation.surface: Someone careless with the baking carries a few cakes out of the house.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shortly' trims ALFRED to ALFRE; 'half of' cuts SCONES to SCO. 'them' points forward to the cakes, recalling the story of Alfred the Great hiding in a cottage and letting the cakes burn.
explanation.definitionFit: The Italian-derived phrase describes doing something in the open air, as with eating or dining out of doors.

clue.text: Curry maybe using fish and horse's heart

parts.note: the skate is a flat sea fish

indicators.note: the heart of a word is its central letter

explanation.surface: A recipe for a curry made with fish and the heart of a horse.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Curry' looks like the dish but is John Curry, the British Olympic figure-skating champion of 1976; 'maybe' marks him as an example.
explanation.definitionFit: John Curry won Olympic gold on the ice, so he is one instance of a figure-skating athlete.

clue.text: Debase theory regularly employed in praise

indicators.note: the selected letters are put to work inside the word for praise

parts.note: to adulate is to praise excessively

indicators.note: every other letter of theory is taken, starting with the first

explanation.surface: A complaint that flattery cheapens a theory used within it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'regularly' takes the odd letters of theory; 'employed in' puts them inside the word for praise. 'Debase' here means spoil by mixing, as with watered milk.
explanation.definitionFit: To adulterate is to make something poorer in quality by adding inferior matter, which is to debase it.

clue.text: Each in Slough having sunk in reputation

indicators.note: one word sits inside the other

parts.note: a slough is a swamp, as is a fen
each and all are close enough in the sense 'every one'

explanation.surface: Someone in the English town of Slough whose standing has dropped.
explanation.walkthrough: Slough is a town west of London, but here it is a common noun: a bog or swamp.
explanation.definitionFit: A fallen person, like a fallen idol or woman, has lost their good standing or moral repute.

clue.text: Man replacing firm in Caledonia's island group

indicators.note: the male pronoun takes the place of the business abbreviation

parts.note: Caledonia is the old Latin name for Scotland
CO is the abbreviation for company, a firm
he is the pronoun for a man

explanation.surface: A man taking over a company somewhere in the Scottish isles.
explanation.walkthrough: 'replacing' swaps the CO in SCOTLAND for HE.
explanation.definitionFit: These northern isles off Scotland form an archipelago, so they are a collection of islands.

clue.text: Nearly thirty-one days needed to make this brandy

indicators.note: almost all of the month name, its final letter dropped

parts.note: March is a month of thirty-one days

explanation.surface: A spirit that takes almost a month to produce.
explanation.definitionFit: Marc is a French brandy distilled from the grape skins and pips left after pressing.

clue.text: See 9
Coin squeezed between two notes in cell

indicators.note: the coin is pressed in the middle of the pair of abbreviations

parts.note: n is the dictionary abbreviation for note, taken twice
the euro is a European coin

explanation.surface: A coin wedged between two banknotes in a prison cell.
explanation.walkthrough: 'notes' suggests music, but N is the standard abbreviation for note.
explanation.definitionFit: A neuron is a nerve cell, the basic unit of the nervous system.

clue.text: Sick as the DA's wayward wife with weapon raised

parts.note: as and like both mean 'in the manner of'

indicators.note: unruly, so the letters stray into a new order

parts.note: W is the genealogy abbreviation for wife
armed means carrying a weapon
up means lifted or raised

explanation.surface: A district attorney's errant wife holds a gun aloft, looking unwell.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wayward' rearranges THEDA into DEATH; the 's of 'DA's' reads as 'is', a link.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom describes someone looking very ill and exhausted, barely revived.

clue.text: Not the time before Christ in traditional saying

indicators.note: negating BC brings in its opposite, the era after Christ's birth

parts.note: an age is a period of time

explanation.surface: A saying that has been around since before the Christian era, or perhaps not.
explanation.walkthrough: The time that is not BC is the AD age; the clue writes this as BC AGE with AD (anno Domini) in place of BC.
explanation.definitionFit: An adage is a proverb or old maxim handed down over generations.

clue.text: Carnivore's length added to value

indicators.note: the length abbreviation is appended to the end of the word for value

parts.note: to rate is to value

explanation.surface: An animal's length adds to its worth.
explanation.definitionFit: The ratel, or honey badger, is a meat-eating mammal of Africa and Asia.

clue.text: Three notes — the last penned by my entrant after deadline

indicators.note: the final one of the three notes is enclosed by the exclamation

parts.note: la, te and me are three notes of the sol-fa scale
cor is an exclamation of surprise, like 'my!'

explanation.surface: A musician's three notes, the last written by an entrant who missed the cut-off.
explanation.walkthrough: From LA, TE, ME the last note ME goes inside COR, giving LA TE CO(ME)R.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who arrives or enters after the closing time is a late arrival.

clue.text: Boy consuming egg and bones

indicators.note: the word for boy eats the other word, holding it inside

parts.note: a son is a boy
to egg on is to urge

explanation.surface: A boy eating eggs and bones for dinner.
explanation.walkthrough: 'egg' is a verb here, and 'bones' is short for sawbones, slang for a doctor who operates.
explanation.definitionFit: Sawbones, shortened to bones, is old slang for a doctor who performs operations.

clue.text: An adolescent male dressed finally in rubber

parts.note: an gives the article A
a lad is a young male

indicators.note: the final letter of the word dressed is taken

explanation.surface: A teenage boy dressed in rubber.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rubber' is not the material but one who rubs: the pantomime hero who rubs the magic lamp.
explanation.definitionFit: In the tale, the hero summons the genie by rubbing the lamp, so he is its rubber.

clue.text: Searching for peace, hail soothing application

parts.note: to be after something is to seek it
sh is a call for quiet
ave is the Latin greeting, hail

explanation.surface: Someone looking for peace who finds a soothing remedy.
explanation.definitionFit: This lotion is applied to the face after a razor to calm the skin.

clue.text: Love excellent final letter

parts.note: love is zero in tennis, shown as O
mega is slang for great or excellent

explanation.surface: A love letter that is the best one ever written, or the last.
explanation.definitionFit: It is the last letter of the Greek alphabet, so the final one.

clue.text: River to surge up — that involves constant worry

parts.note: the Exe is a river in Devon

indicators.note: the rise contains the constant

parts.note: to rise is to surge up
c is the scientific symbol for a constant, such as the speed of light

explanation.surface: A river flooding, causing endless worry.
explanation.walkthrough: C goes after the R of RISE, giving RCISE; 'worry' is a verb.
explanation.definitionFit: To be exercised about something is to be troubled by it, so the verb can mean to cause concern.

clue.text: Shot in Florida

indicators.note: the letters lie inside the name of the US state

explanation.surface: A shooting in Florida.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Shot' reads as gunfire, but means freed, as in 'get shot of'.
explanation.definitionFit: To be shot of something is to be free of it, just as to be quit of it.

clue.text: Massive star made by two different pandas

parts.note: the red panda is one of the two different kinds
the giant panda is the other kind of panda

explanation.surface: A huge celebrity created from a pair of unrelated pandas.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a large luminous star late in its life, swollen and cool.

clue.text: Home supporter on course for keeping record

indicators.note: the golf peg holds the record inside it

parts.note: a tee supports the ball on a golf course
an EP is an extended-play record

explanation.surface: A home fan at the racecourse who keeps a record.
explanation.definitionFit: A tepee is a conical tent used as a dwelling by Plains peoples of North America.

clue.text: Divorcee and excitable maiden investigated

parts.note: an ex is a former spouse

indicators.note: easily stirred up, so the letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: A divorcee and a nervous young woman were questioned.
explanation.definitionFit: To examine something is to inspect or investigate it closely.

clue.text: Pressure on nurse to present claim

parts.note: P is the symbol for pressure
re means on, concerning
to tend is to nurse

explanation.surface: Someone leaning on a nurse to file a claim.
explanation.definitionFit: To pretend to a title or throne is to put forward a claim to it, the older sense of the verb.

clue.text: Romeo in drama's Brosnan?

indicators.note: the letter goes inside the word for drama

parts.note: a piece is a play, a drama
Romeo is R in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: Pierce Brosnan cast as Romeo in a play.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark shows that the definition is an example: the actor Pierce Brosnan.
explanation.definitionFit: The Irish actor who played James Bond has this as his first name.

clue.text: Doctor boarding for South Africa's historic island

indicators.note: the doctor gets on board, inside the other letters

parts.note: SA is the abbreviation for South Africa
MO is a medical officer, a doctor

explanation.surface: A doctor sailing for South Africa from a historic island.
explanation.definitionFit: Formosa is the old Portuguese-derived name for Taiwan, so the island's former title.

clue.text: Female is into the kinky behaviour

indicators.note: the two-letter word goes inside the scrambled letters
twisted, so the letters of the are bent into a new order

explanation.surface: A woman who enjoys kinky behaviour.
explanation.walkthrough: 'kinky' rearranges the letters of 'the' to ETH; 'into' places 'is' within them.
explanation.definitionFit: A fetish is an obsessive fixation, often sexual, that drives a person's conduct.

clue.text: Bird heading for oven — one having stuffed part

indicators.note: the head, or first letter, of the word oven
the numeral is stuffed inside the part, like a bird for roasting

parts.note: a role is an actor's part
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A bird destined for the oven, part of it stuffed.
explanation.definitionFit: The oriole is a bright yellow and black songbird.

clue.text: His curate prepared bread and wine

indicators.note: made ready, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A clergyman's assistant got the bread and wine ready.
explanation.definitionFit: Holy Communion is the Christian rite in which consecrated bread and wine are shared.

clue.text: God shows an interest? Not initially!

indicators.note: the opening letter is removed

parts.note: someone who cares shows interest

explanation.surface: Does God take an interest? Not at first.
explanation.definitionFit: Ares is the Greek god of war.

clue.text: Republic had at first two small islands

indicators.note: the first letter of the word had

parts.note: an ait is a small river island, and I is the abbreviation for island

explanation.surface: A republic that once held a pair of small islands.
explanation.walkthrough: An ait (or eyot) is a British term for a small island in a river.
explanation.definitionFit: This Caribbean state became the first independent black-led nation and is a constitutional republic.

clue.text: Class answer godly person sitting in church

indicators.note: the letters sit inside the church abbreviation

parts.note: CE is the Church of England
ST is the abbreviation for saint

explanation.surface: A pious person sitting in church gives the class an answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A caste is a hereditary social rank, such as in the Hindu system.

clue.text: Architect perhaps critical about very English country home

indicators.note: critical comes round to follow very, so the two pieces swap places in the build

parts.note: John Nash designed Regent Street and the Brighton Pavilion
critically ill, so ill

explanation.surface: An architect is very critical of an English country house.
explanation.walkthrough: 'country home' looks like a stately house, but means the home of country music: Nashville, Tennessee.
explanation.definitionFit: The Tennessee city is famed as the capital of country music, its spiritual home.
